title: Cu/C-catalyzed azide-alkyne cycloaddition
protocol: Benzyl azide (0.50 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and phenylacetylene (0.55 mmol, 1.1 equiv) were combined with Cu/C catalyst (10 mol% Cu) in acetone (2.0 mL; benzyl azide concentration 0.25 M). The homogeneous liquid reaction mixture was heated under microwave batch conditions at 150 °C for 3 min. The corresponding 1,4-disubstituted 1,2,3-triazole was isolated in 94% yield.

BATCH PROCEDURE
Benzyl azide (0.50 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and phenylacetylene (0.55 mmol, 1.1 equiv) were combined with Cu/C catalyst (10 mol% Cu) in acetone (2.0 mL; benzyl azide concentration 0.25 M). The homogeneous liquid reaction mixture was heated under microwave batch conditions at 150 °C for 3 min. The corresponding 1,4-disubstituted 1,2,3-triazole was isolated in 94% yield.
